source_text: Rursum de Aethiopissa et de lepra Mariae. Aaron et Maria de Moyse locuti correpti sunt; Maria septimana in lepra manet. Populus non movetur donec mundetur Maria. Haeretici et obtrectatores leprosi in anima extra castra ecclesiae habentur.
pass_a_gloss: Again concerning Cushite and concerning leprosy of-Miriam. Aaron and Miriam about Moses having-spoken were-rebuked; Miriam for-week in leprosy remains. People not is-moved until is-cleansed Miriam. Heretics and detractors leprous in soul outside camps of-church are-held.
pass_b_english: Again on the Cushite wife and Miriam’s leprosy. Aaron and Miriam, speaking against Moses, are rebuked; Miriam remains leprous a week. The people do not move until Miriam is cleansed. Heretics and slanderers are held leprous in soul [[outside the camp of God’s church >> Bible:Numbers 12:14-15]].
notes: Title line soft/missing in Baehrens OCR — sliced by discourse + running headers.
